summary: Practise CQ reflection, cross-cultural feedback and team agreements in a five-day course. Explore the outline and find the right fit.
lede: Cultural intelligence training helps team leaders, people managers and project leads adapt leadership across cultural contexts. Participants use the CQ model and Cultural Intelligence Scale to reflect on assumptions, distinguish observed behaviour from interpretation, and examine communication expectations. They practise adapting feedback, addressing disagreement and setting team working agreements for remote, hybrid or multicultural collaboration.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who lead, coordinate or advise teams where cultural expectations shape day-to-day work. It suits foundation-level learners seeking practical ways to review their assumptions and adjust leadership behaviour.
prerequisites: No formal cultural intelligence background is expected. General workplace experience involving team communication or coordination will help you apply the scenarios.
